(function () {
  if (window.innerWidth < 768) {
    return;
  }
  const globalMenuForUser = document.querySelector(".navbar ul.global-menu-for-user");
  const globalMenuForUserAnchorItems = globalMenuForUser.querySelectorAll("li a");
  const filteredAnchorItems = [];

  globalMenuForUserAnchorItems.forEach((item) => {
    if (!item.href) {
      return;
    }
    const { pathname } = new URL(item.href);
    if (pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).length === 1) {
      filteredAnchorItems.push(item);
    }
  });

  const cosenseBase64Icon = `data:image/png;base64,`;
  filteredAnchorItems.forEach((item) => {
    const img = document.createElement("img");
    const projectName = new URL(item.href).pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
    img.src = `https://scrapbox.io/api/pages/${projectName}/favicon/icon`;
    img.style.width = "24px";
    img.style.height = "24px";
    img.style.marginRight = "4px";
    img.onerror = () => {
      img.src = cosenseBase64Icon;
    };
    item.prepend(img);
  });
})();
